purpose: Test the standalone CopperStart replacement ROM with one real title at a time on the unchanged Lightweight engine.
workflow: Use an explicitly supplied ROM and local disk; record their hashes and the selected ZIP entry.
Run from reset with a fixed machine, bounded captures and recorded input. Use scripts/probes/CopperStart/replay.py with a fresh output directory for each run.
Record boot, loading, intro/effects, menu and input-driven gameplay separately after inspecting captures. Runner completion alone is not a compatibility pass.
For a failure, compare the same disk, configuration and input against native Kickstart; use a scalar replay and an original synthetic disk to narrow the boundary where useful.

Keep the first blocker, its evidence and the next investigation with this title before adding another title. Prefer classic-compatible service behavior over defensive checks against caller misuse: fixed-address loaders need not allocate their destinations through Exec. Resolve demonstrated live-state conflicts rather than rejecting legal caller memory. Do not patch disk contents.

firstBlocker.subsystem: CopperStart bootstrap memory layout / native trackdisk destination validation
firstBlocker.explanation: The loader read falls outside both published MemHeader ranges. NativeTrackDiskDevice.ValidBuffer rejects it. BootstrapCore reserves a 128 KiB supervisor-stack range from $58000 to $78000. The loader continues into unloaded RAM; by field 70 PC is zero and repeated exceptions subsequently overwrite bootstrap diagnostics.
firstBlocker.nextStep: Investigate a general bootstrap/resident memory layout compatible with fixed-address takeover loads, preserving live stack and service ownership. Rebuild and qualify the CopperStart ROM, then repeat this exact disk before moving to title 2.
firstBlocker.resolution: Resolved by removing allocator-range authorization from trackdisk caller buffers. The first load uses unused reserved space clear of the live stack; no stack relocation was required.

followup.fix: NativeTrackDiskDevice.ValidBuffer now accepts non-null, non-wrapping caller addresses without an Exec MemHeader whitelist. Null/wrap and live device-workspace checks remain. No title-specific behavior or disk patch is introduced.

fixedAddressRegression.dataComparison: All 30208 bytes match the original generated disk after the fix and under native Kickstart.

limits: The original pre-fix replay used the October 13 image; the follow-up recompiles the ROM and passes the 23 native disk-boot/device tests. It does not rerun the complete DOS/console/reader qualification suites.
Only the supplied Lotus 2 variant and bounded opening-race interval are qualified. Complete races, game completion, saves and disk swaps remain unverified.
Native Kickstart and the original second-stage disk are controls, not successful CopperStart real-game replays.
Captures, ROMs, media and run manifests remain ignored local artifacts; only this evidence summary and the recorder are tracked.
Diagnostic FPS and allocation totals are not acceptance measurements. No historical performance evidence is replaced.
